predictions.rationale: Special-purpose notation provider for Sequence Diagram messages ("SD" prefix). Directly involved in rendering/formatting message elements in sequence diagrams.
Holds notation settings for Sequence Diagrams ("SD" stands for Sequence Diagram). Core configuration object used while drawing sequence diagrams.
Abstract base for UML message notation; sequence-diagram messages are concrete subclasses. Provides shared behavior used in sequence diagram rendering.
Concrete UML message notation class. Messages are the primary elements shown on sequence diagrams, so this class directly supports the feature.
Generic (tool-independent) message notation provider. Supplies cross-diagram support but heavily used by sequence diagrams for message text.
Explorer navigation rule that links classifiers to their sequence diagrams. Indicates explicit knowledge of sequence diagrams.
Explorer rule connecting operations to sequence diagrams, enabling navigation and discovery of interaction behavior.
Relates interactions (core of sequence diagrams) to their messages in the model explorer, directly supporting sequence diagram structure.
Explorer rule showing messages attached to an association role; such messages appear on sequence diagrams, aiding diagram navigation.
Developer tool for building message nodes; although in dev module, it manipulates message elements relevant to sequence diagrams.
